purpose: Operational request and manifest intake only; not a scientific reentry or another CLK005 absence audit.
authority: Operator requested a new goal and its execution. DCTRL-000047 scientific PARK_OR_BLOCK remains unchanged.
reference_syntax: attachment_id#declared locator. Byte integrity is checked; locator resolution, semantic support, owner identity and permission authenticity are NOT checked.
limit_scope: Tooling resource limits only, not scientific cutoffs. Larger or other-format submissions need explicit intake review, not scientific rejection.
researcher_obligations: Actual v(x), coordinate matching, gamma_eff(x), coupling-domain validity and non-duplicated theory remainders remain researcher obligations.
An influence row requires epoch/bin alignment; a bare Gram matrix does not calibrate arbitrary new templates.
Freefall normalization/error, full atomic/material sensitivities and joint coverage interpretation remain open.
No retrospective observation receives prospective holdout credit.
acceptance: One unsent owner request, one fillable manifest, a local-only closed-schema/hash checker, synthetic adversarial tests, independent review and release-gated integration.
boundaries: No web search, owner contact, new source acquisition, empirical fit, model change, new theorem, physical promotion or automated successor.
All packet completeness labels concern manifest fields only, not numerical payload, coverage, authenticity or scientific sufficiency.
The validator never executes, downloads, unpacks, publishes or modifies attachments.
Actual correspondence and restricted data stay local; receipt does not grant redistribution.
exit: Tooling complete is distinct from empirical admission. Reenter science only after substantive new evidence and a bounded authorized review.
